name: Bruce Fink
shortBio: American psychoanalyst, translator, and Lacanian scholar who systematized Lacanian clinical technique and theory for the Anglophone world, formalizing the divided subject ($) and the clinical dynamics of jouissance.
centralQuestion: How does Lacanian psychoanalytic speech operate through scansion and interpretation to displace neurotic symptoms toward subjective realization and engagement with unconscious desire?

keyWorks.title: The Lacanian Subject: Between Language and Jouissance
keyWorks.description: Systematic theoretical treatise explaining alienation, separation, and the traversal of fantasy.

keyWorks.title: A Clinical Introduction to Lacanian Psychoanalysis: Theory and Technique
keyWorks.description: Definitive clinical guide to punctuation, variable-length sessions, and structural diagnosis.

keyWorks.title: Lacan on Love: An Exploration of Seminar VIII, Transference
keyWorks.description: Detailed examination of love, transference, and lack across Plato's Symposium and Lacanian theory.
